India-Japan 2+2 Dialogue Held in Tokyo; Trump, Xi, Putin Meet in Shenzhen

India's Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar were in Tokyo for the 4th India-Japan 2+2 Dialogue, focusing on maritime security, defence cooperation, co-development, and technology collaboration. Meanwhile, in Shenzhen, Chinese President Xi Jinping greeted US President Donald Trump upon his arrival for a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin. This three-way meeting, occurring on the sidelines of the APEC summit, was expected to address issues including Ukraine, Iran, and trade, with Putin anticipating significant potential benefits. Separately, leaders of the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue met in Manila to discuss maritime security and critical supply chains.
